skipSemantics: May-skip, not must-skip: a listed test that runs and passes on a machine where its precondition holds is green. Matching is exact on the pre-'(' portion of the TRX result testName (xunit theory rows serialize with arguments, e.g. Class.Method(x: 1)); a name with no parens matches whole. Anchor is the TRX result list, never Counters arithmetic.
admissionRule: allowedSkips is not a quarantine list. A test may be listed only when its precondition is a property of the machine or OS that cannot be satisfied by configuration during a contract run, and its change names the machine class where it executes. Two named PERMANENT BANS apply: (1) CcpClient.Tests.DataRootOverrideTests.DefaultSettingsPath_EnvUnset_IsThePlatformDefault must never be allowed to skip because a process-wide CCP_DATA_ROOT override makes the floor vacuous; (2) CcpClient.Tests.ChaosTunnelLoopbackTests.Logging_RouteClassesOnly_NeverFilenameOrQuery must be fixed at the source, never quarantined.
bumpRule: Bump total only in the same commit as the test change that moves the count, with the reason recorded here. Never widen, disable, or special-case a check to make a step pass. Adding a name to allowedSkips requires the admission rule above and the machine class where it executes.
lastMovedBy: Two lanes. ARCADEMY SLICES 6 AND 8 (+15 unit, +2 headless). Slice 6 is the SAFETY slice and was done first: the panic ladder, so an Esc inside a class cannot reach the application. Every rung is mutation-checked - dropping the 2s window reds the boundary fact, always waiting for exit-done reds both immediate-close facts, not clearing the freeze on a granted resume reds the resume fact, and the ORDER fact counts authority calls (zero) rather than reading code, so reordering the gates makes it one. AN HONEST LIMIT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN PAPERED OVER: the port has no app-wide panic hook to hand a press to, so the board's feared fall-through cannot occur today because the fall-through TARGET does not exist - the rung above it is written and proved for when it does. Slice 8 puts the T2 bar behind the door in upstream's own order (door checked synchronously BEFORE the first await), and the Play-tab entry ships HIDDEN and is re-asserted on every mount; two headless facts prove it is mounted and unreachable, and revealing the strip reds both. Two source-versus-spec corrections landed with it: resume-request is slice 6's frame rather than slice 5's (upstream refuses every reason but panic), and the AudioOnlySession gate is NOT ported because this build has no audio-only session for it to refuse - a hard-coded false would be a gate pretending to have an input. THE TRAINER CARD'S HEADED GATE (+1 unit): the verification harness gained a trainer-card surface, driven to the Graded Intake door by REAL INPUT and gated on the CARD'S OWN UIA text - title, all four award-row names, the record note - before any pixel is read, plus a refusal on any share/export-shaped button, because a pixel cannot see a control that is not there. Measured: ground 108932/108932 = 1.000, ink 671/3020 = 0.222. A real wrong-capture inversion scores 0.013 and 0.000 against a dashboard capture. NO UNIFORM CAPTURE CAN PASS: the two colour bands are disjoint by arithmetic, and the new fact asserts that over the manifest itself rather than trusting the numbers - which is the vacuous green that CAPTURE PASS over an all-black image already cost this board once. The harness's own guard fired on the first run BEFORE reading the screen, on a misplaced ink band, and the BAND was moved to the measured line rather than the expectation being moved. CcpClient.Tests 2778 to 2794, CcpClient.HeadlessTests 159 to 161.
